findings.note: Written testimony to a U.S. House Oversight subcommittee. He speaks about the 2021 Texas election bills SB 7 and HB 3 (poll watchers, voter assistants, drive-through and 24-hour voting, Sunday voting). The testimony does not address photo ID or proof of citizenship.
